svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Writing lint after the rule merge
svg.desc: The osf CLI resolves config, runs the writing rule set, and applies suppressions; the six retired rules are gone and unplaceable-reference carries their work.
